summary: IperionX Limited filed a Form 6-K furnishing its Annual Report for fiscal year 2026, an ordinary foreign-private-issuer disclosure equivalent to a US Form 20-F annual report. The filing contains shareholder letter, financial statements, mineral resources statement, governance and director disclosures, with no transaction, stake, price, premium, advisor, or board recommendation regarding any special situation. No acquisition, divestiture, tender, going-private, spin-off, activist, restructuring, or capital-return event is present. Risk-arb angle: none; monitor future 6-K filings for operational titanium production updates rather than deal activity.
